lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the branchial region, specifically forming three distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns with increasing inter-spot distance toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (top) to shadow (bottom), running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch exhibiting skin texture loss located on the upper flank, dorsal to the fifth gill slit and anterior to the first dorsal ridge.
